latestVersion.changelog:
Build and deploy live blockchain automation workflows on K3 through natural language.

 - Describe what you want — wallet alerts, DeFi pool reports, token price tracking, NFT dashboards, Telegram bots — and the skill builds and deploys the full workflow for you.
 - Handles the entire process: clarifying your request, discovering the right data source (TheGraph subgraphs, on-chain contracts, market APIs), testing the data, and verifying the workflow runs end-to-end before handing it off.
 - Supports all K3 trigger types: scheduled, smart contract events, wallet activity, Telegram chatbot, and on-demand.
 - Covers the full output stack: email, Telegram, Slack, Google Sheets, and on-chain actions via Uniswap, Coinbase, and token transfers.
 - Requires the K3 MCP to be connected. Checks your team's active integrations before building so it always uses what's already wired up.
